label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee / community hospitality surprise for the mayor: prepare and place 200 fresh loaves on the great hall's feast tables, install eight lanterns, and have the innkeeper bring the unsuspecting mayor to the hall at 18:00 the next day. Baker knowingly assisted by supplying and baking paid-for loaves and allowing oven use; the innkeeper, freight, and builder organized and carried out preparations. The mayor was kept unaware of the surprise itself, although he accepted a misleadingly described hospitality presentation appointment.
